integrity: All theorem arguments and reproducibility instructions are included; finite numerical tests complement, rather than substitute for, the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Statements cover one oriented vertex deletion from the complete type-A root polytope. Gaussian exponential limit is weak convergence and uses classical extreme-value theory. Earlier positive-root deletion and crown-graph loss studies have related but nonidentical configurations. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: One oriented-root deletion: a crosspolytopal cap and three scales of geometric loss
